releaseNotes: V978 strengthens the No-Criteria AI output contract so local models do not expand Operational readiness or connection facts into unsupported process-health claims.

When deterministic Condition is NOT EVALUATED with No Criteria, the prompt now requires a bounded semantic frame: report operational facts as observations and state that Process Condition cannot be classified without explicit health/normality criteria.

A final output gate is appended after Evidence to prevent phrases such as 'connected and healthy', 'value is high', or 'appears normal'; the same contract is present during the existing one-time corrective retry because retry uses the same analysis-content builder.

AiGroundingValidator, deterministic evaluation, V975 status-card UI, AI Data Library, Safe Disconnect, communication, Polling/MAX, PDO/ISDU, Studio Runtime, HMI read-only, and Signal Tower hardware-control paths are unchanged.

en: Strengthened the No-Criteria AI output contract without weakening Grounding validation.
Operational READY/connection facts may no longer be paraphrased as process health or normality.
A final post-Evidence output gate reinforces NOT_EVALUATED wording for both the first response and the existing corrective retry.
No change to Grounding Validator, deterministic evaluation, or protected runtime/control paths.
ko: Grounding 검증 강도는 그대로 유지하고 No Criteria AI 출력 계약만 강화했습니다.
Operational READY/연결 사실을 Process 정상·건강 판정으로 바꾸지 못하도록 명시적으로 분리했습니다.
Evidence 뒤 최종 출력 게이트를 추가해 첫 응답과 기존 1회 교정 Retry 모두 NOT_EVALUATED 의미를 유지하도록 했습니다.
Grounding Validator, 결정론적 평가 및 보호된 Runtime/제어 경로는 변경하지 않았습니다.
ja: Grounding 検証を緩和せず、No Criteria の AI 出力契約のみを強化しました。
Operational READY／接続の事実をプロセスの正常・健全判定へ拡張しないよう明確に分離しました。
Evidence 後の最終出力ゲートにより、初回応答と既存の1回の修正 Retry の両方で NOT_EVALUATED の意味を維持します。
Grounding Validator、決定論的評価、保護された Runtime／制御経路は変更していません。
zh-CN: 在不放宽 Grounding 验证的前提下，仅强化了 No Criteria 的 AI 输出契约。
明确禁止把 Operational READY／连接事实扩展为流程健康或正常判断。
在 Evidence 后增加最终输出门控，使首次回答和现有的一次纠正 Retry 都保持 NOT_EVALUATED 语义。
未修改 Grounding Validator、确定性评估及受保护的 Runtime／控制路径。
de: Der No-Criteria-Ausgabevertrag wurde verstärkt, ohne die Grounding-Prüfung abzuschwächen.
Operational-READY-/Verbindungsfakten dürfen nicht mehr als Prozessgesundheit oder Normalität umformuliert werden.
Ein abschließendes Ausgabegate nach den Evidence-Daten erzwingt die NOT_EVALUATED-Semantik sowohl bei der ersten Antwort als auch beim vorhandenen Korrektur-Retry.
Grounding Validator, deterministische Bewertung und geschützte Runtime-/Steuerpfade bleiben unverändert.
es: Se reforzó el contrato de salida No Criteria sin relajar la validación de Grounding.
Los hechos de Operational READY/conexión ya no pueden reformularse como salud o normalidad del proceso.
Una compuerta final de salida después de Evidence refuerza la semántica NOT_EVALUATED tanto en la primera respuesta como en el reintento correctivo existente.
No se modificaron Grounding Validator, la evaluación determinista ni las rutas protegidas de Runtime/control.
